_what: A person's link-in-bio page (src/link-page.mjs, drawn by src/link-page-pages.mjs, set on the Link in bio screen by src/link-page-screen.mjs and by any AI with read_link_page / set_link_page). `record_type` and `record_id` are the one record the page's choices are kept as, so a rule can watch it. `place_param` is the query parameter a bio address carries to say where it was put (`/l/<code>?from=instagram`); a visit without one, or with one that is not a plain word, counts under `unknown_place`. Each click leaves with `link_tags` added, each fixed (`value`) or taken from the click (`from`: place or item, the post or link that was opened), so a sign-up that came through the page says which post or link and from which place; a post's own link keeps the post's id as its item, the same value its posts carry (src/social-posts.json link_tags). `post_statuses` are the post states whose link the page lists. `recent_days` is the window the recent counts cover. `words` are every word the page and the screen say.

words.gone_body: The person who shared this link has turned their page off, or the address is not right.
words.made_with: Make your own page with Trillion
words.screen_lead: One page with your links and your latest posts. Put its address in your bio, and see what people open and where they came from.

words.links_lead: Your own links, shown above your posts.
words.no_links: No links yet. Add the first one below.

words.no_posts: No published post carries a link yet.

words.no_counts: Nobody has visited your page yet.
